_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'simples', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aFazer', "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("priority" BETWEEN 0 AND 3), "start_at" INTEGER NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "has_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_time" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence_rule" TEXT NULL, "reminder_minutes_before" INTEGER NULL, "estimated_pomodoros" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "color_key" TEXT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_completions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "occurrence" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'azul', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("task_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pomodoro_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "planned_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paused_at" INTEGER NULL, "paused_total_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "decks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notebooks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "color_key" TEXT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_pages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "notebook_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notebooks (id), "parent_page_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES note_pages (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flashcards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "deck_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES decks (id), "task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "source_page_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES note_pages (id), "front" TEXT NOT NULL, "back" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'learning', "step" INTEGER NULL, "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, "due" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_review" INTEGER NULL, "suspended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("suspended" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES flashcards (id), "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rating" BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "reviewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_page_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "page_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES note_pages (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("task_id", "page_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "server_version" INTEGER NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX pomodoro_sessions_task_started ON pomodoro_sessions (task_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX note_pages_notebook_sort ON note_pages (notebook_id, sort_order)
